additional_context: The originating Zulip thread selected text/fhir-mapping; charset=utf-8 and led to the Jira. The page is in build/navigation scope via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. A current IANA registry check did not find text/fhir-mapping, but registry work is external to this source checkout and the Jira resolution was to attempt registration while updating documentation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active FHIR source already contains the requested documentation and no safe or necessary core source edit remains.
